entries.zh: 乘；凭借、趁势（受人宠爱而借势行事）
entries.en: to avail oneself of; to trade on another's favour or affection
entries.notes: R 栏空；M 尾段「l chiey」无法对音，仅凭 H「乘」与西语 favor 栏推定

entries.zh: 乘势；借势、趁有利情势行事
entries.en: to take advantage of the situation; to ride the momentum of favour
entries.notes: 西语栏 aliños／hiziera 疑误抄，句义不顺；H「乘势」与 M seng sy 完全相合

entries.zh: 着力；出力、尽力（施恩扶助）
entries.en: to favour, to help; to put forth effort (着力)
entries.notes: M 首音作 sio，与 H「着」之 tio̍h 不合，疑形近误录

entries.en: to promote, to raise up; to favour by advancement
entries.notes: M 尾段「mal cay」污损（T99×2），仅 H「超拔」与前二音 thiàu-poa̍t 可据

entries.zh: 重赏、厚赏；施恩颁赏（疑或作「封赏」）
entries.en: to reward generously; to bestow rewards as a favour
entries.notes: H 已标疑（赏/偿）；M 作 fang siang，音近「封赏」hōng-sióng 而非「重赏」，二者未定

entries.zh: 权势；在官场中施恩、倚势
entries.en: power and influence; to favour someone in government

entries.zh: 权要；当权者、居权要之位
entries.en: power and eminence; influential post or person
entries.notes: M 尾段「l iy」疑衍音或污损，H 与前二音 koân-iàu 相应

entries.zh: 乡情；偏袒同乡、照顾乡亲
entries.en: hometown ties; to favour one's own countrymen
to rely on someone's power; to lean on another's influence
to look after; to protect and care for
entries.notes: 西语 velos 疑为 celo（勤谨）之误，与「照顾」义合

entries.zh: 权衡；受主人宠信而居权衡之位
entries.en: favoured by one's lord; to hold the balance of power
entries.notes: H「权衡」与 M cuān heng 相合，但与「受主人恩宠」之义关合较弱

entries.zh: 展脚手；得以施展手脚、行动自如
entries.en: to have elbow room; to be free to act, as one favoured
entries.notes: L 栏止于「faborecido -」；H 已标疑（展/长），M 音合「展脚手」thián-kha-chhiú

entries.zh: 无影话；虚诳不实之言、谣传

entries.notes: M 作「quey: y iong y un」，后段多处污损（T99），仅 quey（易）可定

entries.zh: 轻；轻易、不费力（亦指重量轻）
entries.notes: L 栏 p̄es 疑为 peso（重量）之省写或误录，与 H「轻」相合

entries.en: an easy matter; a thing easily done

entries.zh: 无乜恶；没有什么难的、不难
entries.en: nothing difficult; not hard at all
entries.notes: 「恶」取闽南 oh（难）之义，与西语 sin dificultad 密合；H 已标疑（也/乜）
